title: Camp Supplies
html:
Camp Supplies are Consumables such as Food or Drinks which allow characters to perform a Long Rest, restoring all Hit Points and expended Spell Slots.

Overview

  • Every Food and Drink has an inherent ⁠Camp Supplies value ranging from 1 to 80.
  • At least 40 camp supplies (80 for tactician difficulty, 120 max for custom difficulty) worth of food and / or drinks need to be consumed in order to take a Long Rest. More supplies can be used during a Long Rest, but doing so does not provide additional benefits. If the supplies requirement is not reached and a rest is still taken, only the benefits of a Partial Rest are received by the party instead. Among other limitations, no Short Rest slots are recovered and party members regain only half of their hit points and spell slots.
  • Alcoholic beverages can also be consumed with a  Bonus Action, granting  Alcohol condition to the character.
  • Salami can be also used as a melee weapon.
  • Some supplies can also be used for healing instead:
    • Gruel (3d4⁠⁠Hit Points)
    • Milk bowl (1d4⁠⁠Hit Points)
    • Raspberry (1d4⁠⁠Hit Points)
    • Red Apple (1d4⁠⁠Hit Points) (only some)
    • Suspicious Meat (4d4⁠⁠Hit Points)

Related Achievements

Bedrolls and Breakfast
Take four full Long Rests in a single playthrough - adventuring's tiring work.
Bottoms Up
Long Rest using only alcohol - a time-honoured dwarven tradition.
Punch Drunk
Defeat twenty opponents while a party character is drunk in a single playthough - down them.
